summary.advice.command: Another version replaced the gokaskad command: update Kaskad — 11.
summary.advice.exits_same: Delete the extra key: 8 → 7 → F3, or in the web panel — “Exits”.
summary.advice.gw: The watchdog fixes this itself every minute; if it’s still there — 17 → 5 “Status”.
summary.advice.gw_clock: Quotas start counting again on their own once the clock is synchronised.
summary.advice.gw_conflict: Another server setting is in the way and won’t fix itself: details — 17 → 5 “Status”.
summary.advice.gw_data: Part of the gateway settings is not applied: details — 17 → 5 “Status”.
summary.advice.gw_host_gone: Address gone — choose another one (17 → 4) and reissue the settings to the devices; an external address of a cloud — add it: kaskadctl gw addresses add <address>.
summary.advice.gw_inbound: The cause is in 17 → 5 “Status”. The watchdog restarts the protocol itself every minute.
summary.advice.gw_service: The watchdog restarts the service itself every minute; if that didn’t help — 17 → 5 “Status”.
summary.advice.gw_unfinished: The gateway install was interrupted — finish it: 17 → 6.
summary.advice.gw_xray_ru_open: The watchdog won’t fix this: stop the xray process by hand or reboot the server, then run kaskadctl gw apply; details — 17 → 5 “Status”.
summary.advice.host: The cause and the advice — 22 “Server load & network”.
summary.advice.host_cert: The IP address certificate is not renewing: the cause — 22; the “IP certificate” section of the web panel.
summary.advice.host_clock: Turn on time sync (timedatectl set-ntp true); details — 22.
summary.advice.host_conntrack: Connections or open files are near the limit: details — 22 “Server load & network”.
summary.advice.host_cpu: What loads the processor and what to do — 22 “Server load & network”.
summary.advice.host_disk: Free up disk space; what takes it and the advice — 22 “Server load & network”.
summary.advice.host_io: The server waits for the disk: details — 22 “Server load & network”.
summary.advice.host_loss: The hosting network loses packets: details — 22; if it lasts — a ticket to the hosting provider with this text.
summary.advice.host_mem: Memory is short: details and advice — 22 “Server load & network”.
summary.advice.host_net: The server’s network can’t keep up: details — 22 “Server load & network”.
summary.advice.host_steal: Other customers of the hosting provider take this server’s processor time: details — 22; lasts for hours — write to the hosting provider.
summary.advice.net: The watchdog repairs forwards itself every minute; if it’s still there — 16 “Forwarding engine and migration”.
summary.advice.no_exits: Add a working exit key (17 → 3) or change the default route (17 → 3 → 1).
summary.advice.policy_rc_d: The watchdog removes it itself once apt is free; details — 16.
summary.advice.site_nginx: The watchdog starts nginx itself every minute; if that didn’t help — 19 → 9 “Check site” and nginx -t.
summary.advice.state: Kaskad settings can’t be read: 16 “Forwarding engine and migration” — backups and rollback.
summary.cert_soon: The certificate of {name} expires on {end} (in {days} d): renewal didn’t work.
summary.gw_unfinished: The gateway install was interrupted: the gateway is not on.
summary.help: server summary for the SSH menu (files only)
summary.help_check: check forwards and the gateway now (like the watchdog, no repairs) — takes seconds
